name: The planning agent's plans
blurb: one document per proposal; it proposes and never executes

groups.label: bucket
groups.note: the bucket of the task this plan is about, not the night it was written

owner_legacy.note: the two agents were renamed on 12 Sep 2026 — night-agent for the hour it ran, execution-agent for the job, onto one axis as planning-agent and implementing-agent. core/migrations/migrate-agent-names.py rewrites what is on disk; this is what reads a document that migration never reached, such as one restored from a backup.

hints.Backlog: leave it alone; held back by you, or excluded by a rule
hints.To do: plan it tonight, in this order
hints.Doing: an agent has it right now
hints.Waiting for review: the agent wrote one; it is waiting on you
hints.Ready to be produced: accepted as written, and the implementing agent's half starts
hints.Done: the work it describes is finished

fields.note: the title as it stood when written, the fallback label when about: resolves to nothing

legacy.note: the five words this stream used until 11 Sep 2026, and what each becomes. redo is ready, owned by the planning agent. agreed and actioned are both accepted: he had approved them and the implementing agent's half had not finished, which is what accepted means since 12 Sep 2026 — neither was ever the terminal done this stream now has.
